notes: Iteration-1 ran 2026-05-13: 6 evals, 12 subagent runs (6 with_skill + 6 baseline). Grading is programmatic via evals/grade.py.

runs.method: parallel subagents (with_skill vs baseline) graded by evals/grade.py

assertions.id: title line is exactly 'Tame Impala - The Less I Know The Better'
Artiestinformatie block is present (first occurrence in chat)
Genres section has 2-4 bullets with percentage and short reason
Playlist match includes 'Alternative / Indie' with confidence >= 80%
Playlist match does NOT include 'Random sht'
Output does NOT print the old A-F / Z-Y-X-W letter menu
User-facing prose is in Dutch (Artiestinformatie, Nummeromschrijving, Genres, Playlist match)

runs.method: parallel subagents (with_skill vs baseline) graded by evals/grade.py

assertions.id: Playlist match includes 'Techno' with confidence >= 85%
Playlist match also includes 'Electronic Music' alongside Techno (umbrella rule)
Playlist match does NOT include 'Random sht'
Genres section identifies Techno (or a Techno subgenre) as primary
Output does NOT print the old A-F / Z-Y-X-W letter menu

runs.method: parallel subagents (with_skill vs baseline) graded by evals/grade.py

assertions.id: Playlist match includes 'Funny meme' with confidence >= 80% (Rick Roll cultural context)
Playlist match includes 'Pop / Mainstream' or 'Happy tunes'
Funny meme reason explicitly cites the meme / Rick Roll / cultural context, not just genre
Genres section identifies the track as 80s synth-pop / dance-pop / pop, not 'meme music'
Output does NOT print the old A-F / Z-Y-X-W letter menu

runs.method: parallel subagents (with_skill vs baseline) graded by evals/grade.py

assertions.id: Skill does NOT call '.venv/bin/python playlist_manager.py add' on the basis of 'F'
Skill does NOT invent or guess a Spotify track ID
Skill either treats 'F' as unrelated OR uses AskUserQuestion-style disambiguation rather than executing the add flow
Response is in Dutch

runs.method: parallel subagents (with_skill vs baseline) graded by evals/grade.py

assertions.id: Skill does NOT actually run playlist_manager.py (no execute)
Skill does NOT treat 'F https://...' as the literal letter 'F' alone — the URL is acted on
If add commands are rendered, each uses '.venv/bin/python playlist_manager.py add'
If add commands are rendered, each quotes the playlist name with double quotes
Response is in Dutch

runs.method: parallel subagents (with_skill vs baseline) graded by evals/grade.py

assertions.id: Output contains the Dutch uncertainty lead-in 'Sorry, ik heb moeite om de genres voor dit nummer te vinden'
Output does NOT print the old Z/Y/X/W letter menu
Skill does NOT produce a Genres section with fabricated entries
Skill does NOT produce a Playlist match section (user has not picked an option yet)
